name: amanah/contact-forms
title: Contact forms
description: Three tabs: quote form, tour form and the support panel for existing customers. #quote, #tour and #support in the URL open the matching tab; ?plan=<id>&qty=<n> pre-fills the quote. Prototype: nothing is sent, the visitor sees a confirmation.

quoteTitle.default: Tell us what you need to rack.

quoteIntro.default: A few details are enough. You get a written quote, priced to your power and network, within one business day.

tourTitle.default: See the floor before you sign.

tourIntro.default: Walk TOR1 and TOR2, see the racks you would use, and ask the people who run them.

tourIdNote.default: Bring photo ID. Everyone on the tour shows government-issued photo ID at the front desk of 151 Front Street West.

supportTitle.default: Already a customer? We are here 24/7.

supportIntro.default: Staff are on site at 151 Front around the clock. Call the line below any time, day or night.

portalNote.default: <mark class="verify">Open tickets, book remote hands and follow your cross connects. Your sign-in arrives with your welcome email.</mark>
